attempts.text:
The two people at Suryagadhi market and Nilkantha temple can't be reached. Their only road (5 min) connects to each other, and the link from Nilkantha to Kalika temple is damaged, so they are deferred. The other five people are rescued in two trips: the first carries 4 elderly from Kalika temple, and the second carries 2 elderly plus the injured person from Syaphru care home (via Kalika temple).

<plan>
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-temple gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 kalika-temple syaphru-care-home
load car1 injured 1
drive car1 syaphru-care-home kalika-temple
drive car1 kalika-temple gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 injured 1
defer nilkantha-temple elderly 1
defer suryagadhi-market adult 1
</plan>
